Description

Developed in cooperation between the National Star Aerospace and the Fighting Fish Network to transmit scientific exploration of positive energy and disseminate knowledge of aerospace science and technology, and accurately promote the transformation of aerospace science and technology education from single to plural, from traditional to modern, using "online + offline" In terms of development, establish a new live broadcast concept."
Notes

Initially thought they were made by ADA Space and were perhaps developed together, but marking Spacety as manufacturer, because fits very well fit with their TY numbering.
